golden.sn: Lies on the vertical axis of symmetry

gnomon.sn: Lies on the vertical axis of symmetry

8229.en: Let A', B', C' be the feet of the internal bisectors and A", B", C" the feet of the external bisectors. The perpendicular bisectors of AA', BB', CC' bound a triangle DEF called the first Sharygin triangle. The perpendicular bisectors of AA", BB", CC" bound a triangle D'E'F' called the second Sharygin triangle. `Reference <http://www.xtec.cat/~qcastell/ttw/ttweng/definicions/d_Sharygin_tr.html>`__

tr.t: for the A-vertex of the 1st Sharygin triangle: bc - \(a^{2}\) : ab + \(c^{2}\) : ac + \(b^{2}\)
for the A-vertex of the 2nd Sharygin triangle: bc - \(a^{2}\) : ab - \(c^{2}\) : ac - \(b^{2}\), (César Lozada, October 22, 2015)

re: X_8229 = inverse of X_3109 in orthoptic circle of Steiner inellipse
no: As a point on the Euler line, X_8229 has Shinagawa coefficients \((2r(R + r), -E - F)\)
